_readme: LEGACY / INACTIVE — the 'Company Fixed Per-Request Charge' section is no longer part of the default report (its rates were partly benchmark-derived and misleading next to official per-token pricing). This file is preserved for reference; an installed copy is never overwritten or migrated. Original description: Company-configured FIXED per-model-request charge policy, used by copilot-task-report.py for the 'Company Fixed Per-Request Charge' report section. The company charges a fixed USD amount per MODEL REQUEST (one OTEL usage-bearing model span, including retried/failed calls that reported usage), keyed by model id and reasoning-effort level. Rates are company-configured fixed per-request amounts; each model entry lists its own 'source' (e.g. the company price list or an Artificial Analysis page). They are NOT official GitHub/Copilot pricing, and the resulting amount is never a verified bill. This file is SEPARATE from model-pricing.json (the independent, approximate token-based USD estimate); the two figures are reported independently and must not be added together. Format: models.<model-id>.rates.<effort-level> = finite, nonnegative number (USD per request) or null (explicitly unpriced). Booleans, strings, negative or non-finite values make the WHOLE file invalid (reported explicitly, never treated as $0). Requests whose effort level is unknown are never priced (no fallback level is assumed). 'aliases' maps another model id spelling to an entry key (or null for explicitly unpriced); alias chains are followed with a cycle guard. Edit freely — the installer only copies this file if it is absent and never overwrites your edits.
